title: The backlog-removal gate ignores gitignored files, so the prompt's 'git checkout puts every file back' promise is false for them
description:
CONFIRMED by an adversarial reviewer during PR #140 (LCLI-467), reproduced end-to-end against that branch's own code in a scratch repo.

backlogRemovalReadiness gates on `git status --porcelain -- backlog` being empty. That command does NOT report IGNORED files. So a backlog/ that is tracked and clean except for an ignored subtree passes the gate, is deleted, and `git checkout -- backlog/` cannot bring the ignored files back.

Reproduction:
  backlog/config.yml, backlog/tasks/task-1.md   committed, clean
  backlog/drafts/idea.md                        matched by .gitignore "backlog/drafts/"
  git status --porcelain -- backlog  -> empty
  readiness -> {"ready":true}
  archive entries include backlog/drafts/idea.md
  git checkout -- backlog  -> restores the two tracked files ONLY; idea.md is gone

THIS MAKES THE PROMPT COPY LITERALLY FALSE. src/commands/init.ts BACKLOG_REMOVAL_NOTICE says "Git is: until you commit the deletion, `git checkout -- backlog/` puts every file back." For an ignored file that is untrue.

MITIGATION (why this is not data loss in practice): the zip DOES contain the file, so it is recoverable by unzipping. But the same copy tells the operator the zip is "a convenience, not the safety net" -- so the user is handed a real recovery route the prompt has just talked them out of trusting. The defect is the false promise as much as the deletion.

WHY THE OBVIOUS FIX IS WRONG: adding --ignored to the status call would refuse every ordinary lore-managed project, because ADR-0012 section 4 makes backlog/.locks/ gitignored BY DESIGN.

TWO SOUND SHAPES, pick one deliberately:
 (a) run planBacklogSnapshot and cross-check it against `git ls-files`, refusing only when a non-.locks file is unaccounted for. Better -- it makes the gate agree with what the archive actually walks.
 (b) soften the copy so it names the zip as the recovery route for anything git is not tracking. Cheap and honest.

Related: LCLI-467's PR fixed the sibling of this (status.showUntrackedFiles=no disarming the UNTRACKED half) before landing; this is the IGNORED half and was left as a follow-up because the zip covers it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: backlogRemovalReadiness refuses (ready:false, with reason) a backlog/ containing a tracked-clean set plus a gitignored file not under backlog/.locks/, proven with a real repro (not only relying on the existing mocked git-transport unit tests)

backlogRemovalReadiness refuses (ready:false, with reason) a backlog/ containing a symlink, instead of readiness saying ready:true and archiveAndDeleteBacklog aborting at exit 6 afterward -- proven with a real repro
backlog/.locks/ (gitignored by design per ADR-0012 section 4) does not trip either new check -- an ordinary lore-managed project still gets ready:true

The BACKLOG_REMOVAL_NOTICE prompt copy (git checkout -- backlog/ puts every file back) is true for every backlog/ state that now reaches ready:true, since the gate itself is what the promise depends on

plan: 1. Read src/backlog-archive.ts backlogRemovalReadiness (git ls-files + git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all only) and planBacklogSnapshot (walks backlog/, refuses symlinks/non-regular entries as LoreError drift)

2. Extend backlogRemovalReadiness to call planBacklogSnapshot, catching its LoreError(drift) and turning it into ready:false with a reason (this alone fixes LCLI-524: symlinks currently pass readiness ready:true then abort archiveAndDeleteBacklog at exit 6)

3. Cross-check planBacklogSnapshot entries against git ls-files output; refuse (ready:false) when a non-.locks entry the snapshot found is unaccounted for by git (this fixes LCLI-523: gitignored files pass git status --porcelain clean but are found by the disk walk)
4. Do NOT regress the ADR-0012 section 4 exemption: backlog/.locks/ is gitignored by design and must not trip the new check
5. Update/extend test/backlog-archive.test.ts for both the ignored-file case (523) and the symlink case (524)

6. Confirm the BACKLOG_REMOVAL_NOTICE prompt copy in src/commands/init.ts still matches behavior (git checkout -- backlog/ restoring everything) now that the gate actually refuses what it cannot restore
7. npm run check equivalent (bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test); lore check --plain if docs touched
implementationNotes: Fixed: backlogRemovalReadiness (src/backlog-archive.ts) now calls planBacklogSnapshot after the existing tracked+clean git checks pass. A caught LoreError (symlink/non-regular entry drift) becomes {ready:false, reason: <LoreError.message>} instead of propagating (closes LCLI-524's gap). Snapshot entries are also cross-checked against git ls-files' tracked set; any regular file on disk not in that set and not under backlog/.locks/ is refused as gitignored-but-present (closes LCLI-523's own gap). backlog/.locks/ is exempted from the cross-check by path prefix only -- self-consistently scoped, since anything under .locks/ that is NOT actually gitignored would already fail the pre-existing status.stdout check before the cross-check is ever reached.

Evidence (real repro, not just the mocked git-transport unit tests): standalone script against a real git repo with .gitignore + real symlinkSync, run once against the pre-fix code (git stash of src/backlog-archive.ts only) and once against the fix. Pre-fix: both the gitignored-file case and the symlink case returned {"ready":true}. Post-fix: gitignored file -> {"ready":false,"reason":"\"backlog/drafts/idea.md\" is gitignored (or otherwise untracked) but present on disk, so `git checkout -- backlog/` could not restore it"}; symlink -> {"ready":false,"reason":"refusing to archive through symlink \"backlog/tasks/note.md\""}; ordinary backlog/ including a populated, gitignored backlog/.locks/ -> {"ready":true} both before and after. Also added 3 permanent real-git tests to test/backlog-archive.test.ts (no mocked transport) covering the same three scenarios; full suite 3199 pass/0 fail, bun run typecheck and bun run lint both exit 0.

AC4 decision: BACKLOG_REMOVAL_NOTICE's prompt copy in src/commands/init.ts is NOT changed. offerBacklogRemoval only ever shows that notice after readiness.ready is true (checked at the call site), so with this fix 'git checkout -- backlog/ puts every file back' is now literally true for every state the notice can be reached from, for the two defect classes this task and LCLI-524 cover. One pre-existing, deliberate exception remains and is now documented in a new code comment on BACKLOG_REMOVAL_NOTICE: backlog/.locks/ contents (gitignored by design, ADR-0012 section 4) are still deleted by archiveAndDeleteBacklog like everything else in the snapshot and are not git-restorable, because they were never tracked. This is unchanged by this fix (AC3 explicitly requires the .locks/ exemption to stay), and ADR-0012 already frames lock files as operational/disposable rather than the Backlog records this promise is about -- flagged for a second opinion rather than silently decided.
